messages.subject: [Rnomads-user] rNOMADS 2.4.2 released
messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

I have released a new version of rNOMADS to account for an upcoming
port change on the DODS system.  If you use DODS, please upgrade by
the planned switch (early April I believe). I've tested it on my
machine but please let me know if you have any issues.

My gratitude to Bill Morris for bringing this change to my attention.

Best

Danny
